why: The whole point of region_only is that no coordinates leave the device. Allowing both would let a study claim minimisation while still uploading precise positions.
If coordinates are withheld, the coarse geography is the only signal left; omitting it makes the observation carry no location information at all.
A fix that cannot be quality-filtered silently corrupts mobility measures, so accuracy is required whenever coordinates are present.
Minimisation state is always recorded, including when nothing was minimised, so a dataset is self-describing without consulting its protocol.
method is what makes the minimisation machine-readable.
Out-of-range coordinates are a classic sign of swapped lat/long or a unit error.
ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 is fixed by the contract so that cross-site joins do not depend on which standard each site happened to use.
Reverse geocoders return names in the device locale, which is exactly the failure Travel Healthy had to work around by pinning the geocoding locale to English.
Providers are enumerated because their accuracy characteristics differ sharply; an open string would let unanalysable values in.
battery_level is a fraction in [0,1]; accepting both scales would make the field meaningless.
Contracts are closed so that a module cannot quietly start shipping a field nobody has agreed to store.
